pages.html:
📷 Alex Rivera

Alex Rivera – Freelance Photographer

Capturing moments, telling stories. Specializing in portraits, events, and landscapes across the Pacific Northwest.

Get in Touch

About Me

With over 8 years of experience, I've had the privilege of documenting life's most important moments. My photography style blends natural light, authentic emotion, and meticulous attention to detail. Whether it's a wedding day, a corporate event, or the perfect landscape, I approach every project with creativity and professionalism.

Based in Seattle, I work with clients throughout Washington and beyond. I believe that great photography isn't just about technical skill—it's about understanding your vision and bringing it to life.

Recent Work

Wedding – Summer 2024

Corporate Portraits

Landscape – Cascade Range

Event Coverage

Portrait – Studio Session

Aerial Photography

What Clients Say

"Alex captured our wedding day beautifully. Every photo tells a story, and the attention to detail is incredible. We couldn't be happier!"
